facts.value: The Student Service Point and the hotline are your central points of contact for questions regarding studies, applications, and student administration.
The central academic counseling supports you competently with all concerns regarding studying.
The Student Administration Office is your reliable point of contact for all questions regarding the organization of your studies.
In the examination offices, you will find contacts for all formal matters concerning your academic achievements, such as thesis submission, exam registration, or certificates.
Goethe University supports international students with comprehensive counseling and service offerings from application to graduation.

The PBS offers you support and a listening ear for personal concerns. In addition to individual conversations, the PBS provides online lectures and workshops every semester on self-reflection, resilience, and stress management.

The PSB supports students with personal and study-related challenges, such as anxiety, loneliness, relationship stress, or learning blocks. In addition to individual and couples counseling, there are also group offerings.
In addition to a diverse sports program, university sports also offers courses and videos for stress management and self-assertion as well as events to become active and make new contacts.

The Career Service supports students and alumni (up to 1 year after graduation) in starting their careers. Strengthen your career competencies through workshops, coaching, and networks - free of charge, practical, and individualized.
Goethe University promotes an equitable and critical environment concerning discrimination and stands for equality, diversity, and inclusion.
Ombudspersons are your contacts for problems, complaints, or suggestions for improvement regarding studies and doctoral programs.
The scholarship service supports students and staff from all disciplines. Find your scholarship and benefit from individualized counseling!
The Student Union offers affordable housing close to campus. Discover numerous dormitories, learn about rental prices, and apply online for your room.
BAföG, scholarships, part-time jobs, or loans – the Student Union Frankfurt provides information on all possibilities for financing your studies and offers individual counseling.
With our newsletter for students, parents, and teachers, and through our social media channels, we regularly inform you about the student offerings of Goethe University.
